items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: The Hightower. I don't know too much of where Hightower.

ctx.x: Did Willie Hightower live around there? Did you ever know him? Willie Hightower. For the Hightower. The Hightower.
The Hightower. I don't know too much of where Hightower. I always think. Oh, Mom!
I think he and Roy Palmer work together. Yeah. Here comes your wife.
